legend: The Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine (Superstition Mountains, Arizona, USA, 1891)
lines: Arizona, 1891. An old German prospector lies dying in Phoenix.
His name is Jacob Waltz, but everyone calls him the Dutchman.
For years he vanished into the Superstition Mountains, and returned with gold.
With his last breath, legend says, he whispered of a secret mine.
It lies near a tall rock spire called Weaver's Needle.
Ever since, thousands of treasure hunters have searched those canyons.
They drew maps and followed old trails, but nobody has found the mine.
Some searchers never returned. Locals say the mountains guard their secret.
Is the gold really buried there, or was it only a dream?
title: The Secret Gold Mine Thousands Have Hunted for 130 Years #shorts
description:
In 1891 an old prospector named Jacob Waltz died, and legend says he whispered of a hidden gold mine in Arizona's Superstition Mountains. Nobody has ever found it.
